uncertain_terms.note: Source header cell renders the document code with Arabic letters 'خ م', evidently a corruption of 'FS'; rendered as the document number 'FS-023-r0a' (doc_number field: FS-023-R0A).
Source uses the Arabic letter د (D, for daily); rendered 'I1-D1' by analogy with the Latin-code form 'I2-M1' used in sibling documents.
Trailing '00' in the source is unexplained; kept verbatim. It may be a corrupted rendering of 'etc.'.
Most of the body survives only as fragments (numbers, single words, ':' placeholders); translated faithfully as printed.
